fidelity: F2a — Thevenin 1-RC Equivalent-Circuit Model with Thermal ODE
source: Takami et al. (2011) J. Power Sources 196, 6989; He et al. (2013) J. Power Sources 239, 269; Hu et al. (2012) J. Power Sources 198, 359 (RC ECM); Kobayashi et al. (2013) J. Power Sources 244, 727; Toshiba SCiB datasheet

unit.name: Generic LTO 18650-class cell (Li4Ti5O12 anode vs LMO/NMC cathode) — Thevenin 1-RC

capacity_ref.source: Takami et al. (2011); Toshiba SCiB datasheet

R0_ref.note: Series (ohmic) resistance at T_ref; very low for LTO due to fast spinel Li+ kinetics
R0_ref.source: He et al. (2013); Hu et al. (2012)

R1_ref.note: Charge-transfer/diffusion polarization resistance of the RC branch at T_ref
R1_ref.source: Hu et al. (2012) J. Power Sources 198, 359 — 1-RC Thevenin fit

C1.note: RC-branch capacitance; tau1 = R1*C1 ~ 12 s polarization time constant
C1.source: Hu et al. (2012); He et al. (2013)

E_a_R.note: Activation energy for resistance Arrhenius scaling; low for LTO spinel
E_a_R.source: He et al. (2013) J. Power Sources 239, 269; Keil & Jossen (2016) J. Electrochem. Soc. 163(9), A1872

alpha_c.source: Bernardi et al. (1985) J. Electrochem. Soc. 132, 5

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient for LTO; small due to flat OCV plateau
dOCV_dT.source: Kobayashi et al. (2013) J. Power Sources 244, 727

hA_cool.note: Convective heat transfer coeff * surface area to ambient (natural convection)

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5 — flat ~2.4 V plateau
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative LTO discharge curve; Takami et al. (2011)

current.note: Negative=charge, Positive=discharge; LTO supports very high C-rates (>10C)

temperature.note: -30 to 60 degC; LTO operates well at low temperatures
